messages:
alex: Kicking off commissioning for eu-central-2 kubeadm cluster (GPU-focused). Quick sync — running a validation + handoff pass now. Ping if you want on the call.

maria: +1. Please include network MTU, route propagation, and control-plane HA checks. Also note region has constrained quota for the big GPU SKUs.

jamal: Plan looks good. GPU driver flow: apply nvidia-driver-daemonset -> verify nvidia-smi -> runtimeClass for gpu workloads. I left a small snippet for containerd runtimeClass.

alex: Rolling checklist I'm following (short):
- VPC peering & routes validated (check MTU 1500 vs 9000 mismatch)
- BGP sessions to edge-router up
- CNI: Cilium (EBPF) in L7-disabled mode, kernel tuning applied
- kube-proxy: ipvs mode enabled
- Node pools: one spot GPU pool (tainted), one on-demand GPU pool (reserved), infra/control-plane pool
- Base addons: coredns, metrics-server, kube-state-metrics, prometheus-node-exporter, external-dns, cert-manager
- GPU driver daemonset + device-plugin + runtimeClass
- Autoscaler config with gpuResourceLimits and scale-down protections

maria: For node flavors be explicit in the runbook: SKU, vCPU, mem, estimated $/hr, and expected throughput. eu-central-2 currently has limited p4 availability — fallback to a2/mixtures and note perf delta.

jamal: GPU validations I run:
```
# on a GPU node
kubectl describe node gpu-node-01 | grep -i allocatable -A2
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l name=nvidia-driver -o wide
ssh ubuntu@gpu-node-01 sudo nvidia-smi
# runtimeclass check
kubectl get runtimeclass nvidia-gpu -o yaml
```
Also make sure the device-plugin exposes the exact resource name we expect (nvidia.com/gpu).

devin: Spot pool tips: label spot=true and add node-termination-handler. Set cluster-autoscaler expander to priority and protect critical infra pods with podPriority + PDBs. For cost tracking include per-pool billing tag so billing reports match node labels.

alex: Network gotcha I hit last time: MTU mismatch between on-prem transits and cloud overlay caused dropped TCP segments for large batched tensor payloads. Test with iperf3 and a 9000/1500 scenario. Also ensure calico/cilium Felix MTU matches VPC.

maria: Add a step to validate IPV6 disabled on the cluster if using certain CNI versions (we ran into kube-proxy issues previously).

deploy-bot: bootstrap-batch-job queued: job_id=cb-1915604321-01, target=eu-central-2, mode=kubeadm, expected-duration=45m

jamal: Addon smoke commands (quick):
```
kubectl get pods -n kube-system --field-selector=status.phase!=Running
kubectl top nodes | sort -r -k2
kubectl logs -n kube-system -l app=external-dns --tail=100
```

alex: Cost decision: for prod reserve a small Dedicated capacity pool for p4s; for staging/dev use a2 spot mixtures. I'll open a reserved-capacity ticket after we confirm perf.

maria: Handoff: tagging runbook, config snippets, and the bootstrap job id. Recommend 48h watch window with @oncall coverage and a rollback playbook for nodepool scale-down.

alex: I'll post the final validation summary here in ~1h with results from the smoke checks and iperf. Thanks all.
